witness_reading: OF VENICE. PERSONÆ. OLD GOBBO, father to Launcelot. LEONARDO, servant to Bassanio. BALTHASAR, servants to STEPHANO, PORTIA, a rich heiress. NERISSA, her waiting-maid. JESSICA, daughter to Magnificoes of Venice, Officers of the Court of Justice, Gaoler, Servants to Portia, and other Attendants. SCENE: Partly at Venice, and sartly at Belmont, the seat of Portia, on the Continent.
